name: book-charger-case-3way
about: Jordan has a BIO 181 textbook and needs a USB-C charger. Nobody with a charger wants a textbook. But Sam has a phone case and needs the textbook, and Priya has a charger and needs a phone case. Leo also wants a USB-C charger, but nobody wants his desk lamp, so he waits.

people.name: Jordan Rivera
people.says: I have a BIO 181 textbook I'll never open again. I need a USB-C charger, fast charging if possible. I'd give the textbook for anything worth at least $30 to me.
people.reasons: My charger died and I have an exam Monday.

people.name: Sam Okoye
people.says: Got an iPhone 15 case, like new. Need a BIO 181 textbook.
people.reasons: I'm retaking BIO 181 in the spring.

people.name: Leo Marsh
people.says: Have a desk lamp, need a usb-c charger.
people.reasons: Mine is at my parents' place.

people.name: Priya Shah
people.says: Have a 20W USB-C charger, good condition. Looking for an iPhone 15 case. Want at least $12 for the charger.
people.reasons: Dropped my phone twice this week.
